<translate>
'''Tamagami Number 1''' is the swordsman who guards the First Demon World, the bottom floor of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]], and the strongest of the three Tamagamis. He punishes careless attacks with counters and teleports. When defeated he doesn't die: he drops the '''1-star Demon Realm Dragon Ball''' on his platform and goes back to sleep for an hour.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding the lair ==

Tamagami Number 1 sleeps on a stone platform on the First Demon World, reached through the giant tunnel that starts at 700, 450 on the Second Demon World. The lairs of the Tamagamis are searched for while players are in the Demon Realm. Once his lair has been located, the [[Special:MyLanguage/Time Patroller|Time Patroller]] in any demon village sells the '''Tamagami Number One Map''' for 20 Emeralds (4 uses).

He wakes when a survival or adventure player comes within 32 blocks of his platform, or when you hit him.
</translate>

<translate>
== How the Tamagamis fight ==

Red circles and lanes on the ground always mark where a move will land. Some moves leave a Tamagami '''exposed''' for a moment: while exposed it takes '''25% more damage'''. When badly hurt, a Tamagami turns into its '''Powered Up''' form, which uses its moves more often (75% of the cooldown) and with extra follow-ups.
</translate>

<translate>
== Moves ==

* '''Counter Stance.''' Don't hit him while he holds it: he teleports behind the attacker and counters for huge damage. If nobody hits him, he slashes around him and is exposed.
* '''Flash Cuts.''' Teleport slashes along red lanes (three in a row when Powered Up).
* '''Chase.''' Keep your distance too long and he teleports behind you.
* '''Catching his breath.''' After a flurry of fast hits he stops to catch his breath.
* '''Duel''' (Powered Up, with 2 or more players). He challenges one player for 8 seconds and meanwhile takes '''50% more damage''' from everyone else.
</translate>

<translate>
== Defeat and rewards ==

When his health runs out, Tamagami Number 1 drops the '''1-star Demon Realm Dragon Ball''' on his platform and becomes dormant for an hour before he can be fought again. The three Demon Realm Dragon Balls, one from each Tamagami, summon [[Special:MyLanguage/Porunga|Porunga]] in the Demon Realm. They never scatter on their own and no radar finds them (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragons and Wishes|Dragons and Wishes]]).

Every contributor also rolls these default rewards (see [[Special:MyLanguage/World Bosses#Rewards|how world boss rewards work]]):
* '''2,700,000 TP''' (guaranteed; the amount scales with your contribution).
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Tamagami Sword|Tamagami Sword]] (30%): a sword with balanced strikes.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story ==

In the [[Special:MyLanguage/Daima Saga|Daima Saga]], the quest '''Tamagami Number 1''' asks you to defeat him on the First Demon World.
</translate>
